blocks.text: FAQs – Study in Europe from Mumbai
Which is the best country in Europe for Indian students?

blocks.html: Germany, Ireland, France, and the Netherlands are among the top choices depending on your course and budget.

blocks.text: What is the cost of studying in Europe?

blocks.html: Tuition fees range from €0 to €20,000 per year, with living expenses between €500 and €1,500 per month.

blocks.text: Is IELTS required to study in Europe?

blocks.html: Yes, most universities require an IELTS or equivalent English proficiency score.

blocks.text: Can I work while studying in Europe?

blocks.html: Yes, students can work part-time in most European countries.

blocks.text: Which European country offers the best post-study work visa?

blocks.html: Ireland offers up to 2 years, while Germany offers up to 18 months.
